code: copies attacker-controlled bytes into sass_data and NUL-terminates them
note: The raw PoC bytes become the stylesheet input consumed by libsass.
The fuzzer hands the attacker-controlled stylesheet to the compiler entrypoint.
The stylesheet is parsed into selector AST nodes, including nested selectors and parent references.
Selector evaluation resolves parent references using the current selector stack.

code: builds a vector of selector-choice vectors and calls permutateAlt(vars)
note: This is the vulnerable path: malformed selector combinations can leave selector-choice state inconsistent before permutation.
The permutation helper reads and updates selector state while combining parent and child selectors; the MSan report indicates an uninitialized-value use here or in the data it consumes.
